title: ericomyrtus serpyllifolia
intro: Ericomyrtus serpyllifolia, commonly known as the white beach heath, is a flowering plant native to Western Australia. The health benefits of Ericomyrtus serpyllifolia include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. This plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Ericomyrtus serpyllifolia include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
